```{r}
#| label: metadata-block
#| echo: false
#| include: true
#| error: false
schedule <- readr::read_csv("../files/schedule.csv", show_col_types = F) |>
  dplyr::filter(module_num == "05")

quarto::write_yaml_metadata_block(
  title = schedule$module_title,
  date = format(schedule$module_date, "%B %d, %Y")
)
```
